thread:
Marta (Sales Eng): Halcyon sent an RFI. They want a 14-day POC in their US VPC, baseline 3 GPUs with burst up to 9, SOC2 evidence, KMIP-compatible HSM option, and a capability matrix mapped to their security controls. Need a draft reply + non-binding cost by tomorrow morning.

Eli (AE): Got it. Confirm whether they require customer-managed certs for mTLS and if audit logs need >90 days retention.

Marta (Sales Eng): Halcyon said customer certs optional but prefer it. Audit retention "flexible, prefer 90+ days if possible". We'll offer default 30 days and paid extensions.

Sam (SRE): Private POC in their VPC is doable. Timeline: peering + 2-node (1.5 GPUs effective) baseline in ~36-48h. KMIP/HSM requires SOW and ~7-10 day lead. Minimal bootstrap snippet for their infra team:
```bash
# run on Halcyon bastion
curl -fsSL https://peering.redwood.ai/agent/bootstrap -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" | sudo bash -s -- --env halcyon-poc --cidr 10.33.0.0/22
```
I'll need their contact, CIDR, and burst windows.

Rina (Solutions): I uploaded halcyon_matrix_v1.xlsx and halcyon_rfi_answers_v1.pdf to the shared drive. Matrix maps features to their control IDs and calls out quantization options, KV prefix caching, routing fallback policies, observability hooks, and per-route cost. SOC2 redacted attached.

Eli (AE): Pricing suggestion: promo 45% off compute for 14-day POC and waive onboarding. Marta ok to offer?

Marta (Sales Eng): Yes. Include line items: prorated reserved baseline (3 GPUs), burst per GPU-hour, egress per TB, and a note that HSM+cert integration is extra. Make quote non-binding.

Sam (SRE): Ballpark non-binding: 3xA100-eq reserved ~ $13k/month; burst ~$15/GPU-hour; egress ~$0.09/GB. With 45% off compute for 14 days estimate ~$1.6k - $2.8k depending on burst. HSM adds eng time + fees.

attachments-bot: SOC2 Type II (redacted) and matrix files attached to shared drive.

Eli (AE): I'll draft the RFI reply with Rina's attachments, Sam's snippet, and the non-binding quote. Marta, confirm Halcyon contact email?

Marta (Sales Eng): Contact is ops@halcyon.io. CIDR they provided: 10.33.0.0/22. They asked for a one-page SLO summary and rollback plan too. Sam 33 can you paste a short rollback checklist?

Sam (SRE): Rollback checklist (short): 1) scale down worker groups; 2) revoke peering and short-lived IAM creds; 3) rotate service keys; 4) collect logs and close trial workspace. I'll add full playbook to the email.

Eli (AE): Approved. Send with trial limits: 14 days, max burst 9 GPUs, trial support at standard level.
